# Maester / NCSC Control Mapping

Shared reference used by the `terraform-security-baseline-auditor` skill. Every Maester test and guidance URL in this table was checked against its stable page on 17 August 2026. Reverify links before adding or changing a row.

> **Upstream issue:** Do not map `MT.1057` to group expiration. Its stable page heading mentions group-expiration notifications, but its overview, remediation, PowerShell test, and source check app registrations for client secrets.

| Area / Control | Verified Maester Test(s) | Exact Test Purpose | Verified NCSC / Microsoft Alignment | Audited Terraform File(s) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Retire weak authentication methods** | [EIDSCA.AS04](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/EIDSCA.AS04)<br>[EIDSCA.AV01](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/EIDSCA.AV01)<br>[CISA.MS.AAD.3.5](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/CISA.MS.AAD.3.5) | **Authentication Method - SMS - Use for sign-in.**<br>**Authentication Method - Voice call - State.**<br>**The authentication methods SMS, Voice Call, and Email One-Time Passcode (OTP) SHALL be disabled.** | [NCSC: Multi-factor authentication for your corporate online services](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/collection/mfa-for-your-corporate-online-services) recommends selecting MFA strength appropriate to the protected service and avoiding weak MFA patterns. | `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf` |
| **Enable attested FIDO2** | [EIDSCA.AF01](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/EIDSCA.AF01)<br>[EIDSCA.AF03](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/EIDSCA.AF03) | **Authentication Method - FIDO2 security key - State.**<br>**Authentication Method - FIDO2 security key - Enforce attestation.** | [Microsoft Entra authentication overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/overview-authentication) identifies FIDO2 and passkeys as phishing-resistant methods. | `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf` |
| **Require phishing-resistant MFA for privileged roles** | [CISA.MS.AAD.3.6](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/CISA.MS.AAD.3.6)<br>[MT.1006](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1006) | **Phishing-resistant MFA SHALL be required for highly privileged roles.**<br>**At least one Conditional Access policy is configured to require MFA for admins.** | [NCSC: Multi-factor authentication for your corporate online services](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/collection/mfa-for-your-corporate-online-services) covers strong MFA for access to sensitive data. | `terraform/conditional-access.tf`, `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf` |
| **Show Microsoft Authenticator login context** | [EIDSCA.AM01](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/EIDSCA.AM01)<br>[EIDSCA.AM09](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/EIDSCA.AM09)<br>[CISA.MS.AAD.3.3](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/CISA.MS.AAD.3.3) | **Authentication Method - Microsoft Authenticator - State.**<br>**Authentication Method - Microsoft Authenticator - Show geographic location in push and passwordless notifications.**<br>**If Microsoft Authenticator is enabled, it SHALL be configured to show login context information.** | [Manage authentication methods](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/concept-authentication-methods-manage) explains that application and location context helps prevent accidental MFA approvals. | `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf` |
| **Use one-time Temporary Access Passes** | [EIDSCA.AT01](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/EIDSCA.AT01)<br>[EIDSCA.AT02](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/EIDSCA.AT02) | **Authentication Method - Temporary Access Pass - State.**<br>**Authentication Method - Temporary Access Pass - One-time.** | [Microsoft Entra authentication overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/overview-authentication) identifies Temporary Access Pass as a supported authentication and MFA method. | `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf` |
| **Complete authentication-method migration** | [CISA.MS.AAD.3.4](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/CISA.MS.AAD.3.4) | **The Authentication Methods Manage Migration feature SHALL be set to Migration Complete.** | [Manage authentication methods](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/concept-authentication-methods-manage) states that Migration Complete centralises MFA and SSPR method control and ignores legacy policy settings. | `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf` |
| **Keep authentication-method group references valid** | [MT.1067](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1067) | **Authentication methods policies should not reference deleted groups.** | [Manage authentication methods](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/concept-authentication-methods-manage) recommends group-based targeting and consolidating target groups when needed. | `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf`, `terraform/security-groups.tf` |
| **Exclude emergency access from Conditional Access** | [MT.1005](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1005) | **All Conditional Access policies are configured to exclude at least one emergency/break glass account or group.** | [NCSC: Zero trust architecture design principles](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/collection/zero-trust/architecture-design-principles) requires identities and access policies to be understood and governed. | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Require MFA for admins, users, and guests** | [MT.1006](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1006)<br>[MT.1007](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1007)<br>[MT.1016](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1016) | **At least one Conditional Access policy is configured to require MFA for admins.**<br>**At least one Conditional Access policy is configured to require MFA for all users.**<br>**At least one Conditional Access policy is configured to require MFA for guest access.** | [NCSC: Multi-factor authentication for your corporate online services](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/collection/mfa-for-your-corporate-online-services) provides current guidance for applying strong MFA to corporate services. | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Block legacy authentication** | [MT.1009](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1009)<br>[MT.1010](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1010) | **At least one Conditional Access policy is configured to block other legacy authentication.**<br>**At least one Conditional Access policy is configured to block legacy authentication for Exchange ActiveSync.** | [NCSC: Zero trust architecture design principles](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/collection/zero-trust/architecture-design-principles) says each request should be authenticated and authorised without trusting the network. | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Require device compliance** | [MT.1001](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1001) | **At least one Conditional Access policy is configured with device compliance.** | [NCSC: Zero trust architecture design principles](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/collection/zero-trust/architecture-design-principles) identifies device health as a policy-engine signal. | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Separate and respond to identity risk** | [MT.1012](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1012)<br>[MT.1049](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1049) | **At least one Conditional Access policy is configured to require MFA for risky sign-ins.**<br>**Conditional Access policies for User Risk and Sign-in Risk should be configured separately.** | [NCSC: Zero trust architecture design principles](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/collection/zero-trust/architecture-design-principles) recommends using user behaviour and other signals in access policy decisions. | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Constrain browser sessions** | [MT.1017](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1017)<br>[MT.1018](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1018) | **At least one Conditional Access policy is configured to enforce non persistent browser session for non-corporate devices.**<br>**At least one Conditional Access policy is configured to enforce sign-in frequency for non-corporate devices.** | [NCSC: Zero trust architecture design principles](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/collection/zero-trust/architecture-design-principles) requires authentication and authorisation decisions to consider multiple signals for every access request. | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Block or limit device code flow** | [MT.1052](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1052) | **At least one Conditional Access policy is targeting the Device Code authentication flow.** | [NCSC: Zero trust architecture design principles](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/collection/zero-trust/architecture-design-principles) requires access requests to be authorised by policy and not trusted by network position. | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Block legacy MSOnline PowerShell** | [MT.1185](https://maester.dev/docs/tests/MT.1185) | **Block legacy MSOnline (MSOL) PowerShell module.** | [Authorization policy - Microsoft Graph](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/authorizationpolicy) documents `blockMsolPowerShell` as the control that disables MSOL PowerShell access. | `terraform/policies.tf` |
